variables.input:
timeseries avg(aerospike_users_conns_in_use), by: { user }
| fields user

timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime), by: { cluster_name }
| fields cluster_name

timeseries avg(aerospike_node_stats_uptime, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster }), by: { service }
| fields service

0.content:
**Users View**: Per-user connections, TPS and quotas. Empty unless security is enabled with users configured. A tile's description shows its equivalent Prometheus query.

**Why it may be empty:** the Aerospike exporter publishes the per-user metrics this dashboard reads (`aerospike_users_*`) only for clusters with security enabled and users configured; without them every tile and the user picker stay empty.

1.title: Connections
1.query:
timeseries value = sum(aerospike_users_conns_in_use, filter: { cluster_name == $cluster and in(service, array($node)) and in(user, array($user)) }, rollup: avg), by: { user }
| fields user, value = coalesce(value[-2], arrayLast(value))
1.description:
Equivalent Prometheus query:
sum(aerospike_users_conns_in_use{job="$job_name", cluster_name=~"$cluster", service=~"$node|$^", user=~"$user"}) by (user)
